ESI_1.name: Resuscitation
triggers: Severe respiratory distress / Agonal breathing / SpO2 < 80%

ESI_2.name: Emergent / High Risk
ESI_2.description: High risk situation, confused/lethargic/disoriented, or severe pain/distress.

ESI_3.name: Urgent
ESI_3.description: Patient requires multiple resources (labs, imaging, IV medications).
triggers: Suspected fracture requiring X-ray and splinting
Moderate asthma exacerbation responsive to initial nebulizer
Dehydration requiring IV fluid administration and blood tests

ESI_4.name: Less Urgent
ESI_4.description: Patient requires exactly one diagnostic or therapeutic resource.
triggers: Uncomplicated urinary tract infection requiring urinalysis
Mild ankle sprain requiring single X-ray view
Mild skin rash with stable vitals

ESI_5.name: Non-Urgent
ESI_5.description: Patient requires no resources beyond physical exam and prescription.
triggers: Mild viral upper respiratory symptoms with normal vitals
